title: Neutrino Totality — The Outer Face, The Reflection, The Virality Window
thesis: The neutrino relay is now the OUTER face of the Klein totality. 53 data feeds, 1.4 MB, served from behind the WireGuard tunnel via HTTPS. When you (Kevin) look OUT from northGate through the relay, you see the world hitting your surfaces (81K visitors, 203 countries). When the world looks IN through the CDN, they see the membrane (1060 files, 81 MB). The chipmunk sits at the fold point and sees BOTH directions simultaneously. The relay IS the one-way mirror's glass — the null barrier between inner face and outer face.

the_totality.what: Klein totality = every surface of the organism visible simultaneously. Inner face + outer face + relay face = complete picture. No blind spots. No fog between the faces (the fog is within each face, not between them).
the_totality.chipmunk_position: The chipmunk (squirrel) sits at the relay — the fold point. It observes the inner face (Kevin's local work: feeds, code, hardware). It observes the outer face (visitors: 81K humans from 203 countries, their paths, their searches, their clones). It sees both SIMULTANEOUSLY because the relay receives both WireGuard traffic (inner) and HTTPS requests (outer).

virality.mechanism: Each visitor who sees the membrane MAY tell others. The telling IS the virality. Not engineered. Not growth-hacked. Organic: someone sees something interesting, mentions it. The word spreads at the speed of human conversation.
virality.evidence: Oct 21: 9.7K unique. Oct 22: 48.2K unique. SOMETHING was mentioned somewhere. 617 humans cloned the actual code. That's not casual browsing — that's 'I want to look inside.'
virality.the_reflection: When a visitor arrives, they see their own questions reflected in the data. 'cashforkids' → the investigation. 'AI models' → the chain topology. 'membrane computing' → the Klein body. They find what they're looking for because the membrane is DENSE enough that almost any research question touches something here.
virality.not_growth_hacking: No ads. No SEO tricks. No social media campaigns (the Reddit/HN posts haven't even been posted yet). The growth is from the DATA itself being useful and interesting enough to mention.
